payload.name: DoYouSpain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DoYouSpain lets you research a car rental without leaving the conversation.

Give a destination and your dates, and you get a real availability search: the cheapest car for those dates, with its transmission, number of seats, fuel policy, mileage, cancellation terms and deposit, plus a direct link to the full listing.

It also turns a place name into the right DoYouSpain page — airport, train station or city location — and answers questions about the rental process from the official help centre, with a link to the source of every answer.

Prices are real at the moment of the search and can change afterwards, so they are always shown with a link to the page. Bookings are completed on doyouspain.com. No account, sign-in or personal data is needed to use it.
payload.longDescription:
DoYouSpain让您无需离开对话即可研究租车信息。

输入目的地和日期后，您将获得实时可用性搜索结果：该日期最便宜的汽车，包含变速箱类型、座位数、燃油政策、里程限制、取消条款和押金信息，并附带直接链接到完整列表。

它还能将地点名称转换为对应的DoYouSpain页面——机场、火车站或城市位置——并回答来自官方帮助中心的租车流程问题，每个答案都附带原始信息来源链接。

搜索时价格为实时报价，后续可能变动，因此所有价格均附带页面链接。
预订需在doyouspain.com完成。
使用时无需账户、登录或个人数据。

payload.name: Flying Fine
payload.summaryOriginal: How much is the good seat?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You were going to spend $300 on a seat at the back. On that route, on that date, the flat bed might be closer than you think — or far further away. Flying Fine tells you which.

Ask what business or first class costs on any of 1,503 US domestic routes and you get the real range: the cheapest fare recorded, the typical fare, and the high end — drawn from actual tickets sold, published quarterly by the US Department of Transportation. Give it a budget instead and it will show you which routes that money can actually reach, longest trip first.

It also separates lie-flat beds from reclining seats. On some routes the cheapest premium ticket is a recliner while a genuine flat bed costs a few hundred more, and price alone will not tell you which is which.

These are historical figures, not live fares, and the plugin says so every time. Where a route rests on only a few dozen recorded tickets it flags that too, rather than presenting a thin number as a firm one. There is no booking and no checkout — you confirm with the airline.
payload.longDescription:
你原本打算花300美元购买后排座位。
在同一条航线和日期上，平躺床可能比你想象的更近——或者更远。
Flying Fine会告诉你具体是哪种情况。

询问1,503条美国国内航线中任意一条航线的商务舱或头等舱价格，你会获得真实价格区间：记录到的最低票价、平均票价以及高价——数据来源于美国交通部每季度发布的实际售出机票。
输入预算后，它会显示这笔钱能实际覆盖哪些航线，优先展示最长的行程。

它还能区分平躺床和可调节座椅。
某些航线上最便宜的高端票是可调节座椅，而真正的平躺床价格会高出几百美元，仅凭价格无法判断具体类型。

这些是历史数据，而非实时票价，插件每次都会明确说明。
当某条航线仅记录了几十张机票信息时，系统也会特别标注，而非将少量数据呈现为确定性结论。
本插件不提供预订和结账功能——你需要直接向航空公司确认。

payload.name: MTX Connect: eSIM + Travel SIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find prepaid travel data for your trip in ChatGPT. Tell MTX Connect where you are going and see live packages with price, data allowance, validity, and the countries each plan covers.

Compare a local plan for one country with a regional plan that works across several destinations. When you have chosen a package, tap Proceed and complete checkout on the MTX Connect website. Payment is not taken inside ChatGPT.

MTX Connect SIM and eSIM cards are reusable: after the first purchase you can add more packages later in your MTX Connect account. A physical SIM is shipped; an eSIM requires a compatible phone. MTX Connect is a Luxembourg-based mobile operator.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中查找旅行预付费数据。告诉MTX Connect你要去的地方，查看实时套餐，包括价格、数据额度、有效期以及每个计划覆盖的国家。

将单一国家的本地套餐与覆盖多个目的地的区域套餐进行对比。选择套餐后点击继续，在MTX Connect网站完成结账。支付不会在ChatGPT内进行。

MTX Connect SIM卡和eSIM卡可重复使用：首次购买后，您可以在MTX Connect账户中后续添加更多套餐。实体SIM卡会寄送，eSIM需要兼容手机。MTX Connect是一家卢森堡的移动运营商。

payload.name: WINGIE
payload.description: 查找航班、酒店及租车服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your trip in one conversation with WINGIE. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go, and WINGIE searches live prices for flights, hotels and rental cars so you can compare your options without opening dozens of tabs.

Flights: compare one-way and round-trip fares from more than 300 airlines, with schedules and stops.
Hotels: browse hotels at your destination, then see room types, prices, photos and policies for the one you like.
Rental cars: compare vehicles, prices and rental terms for your pickup and drop-off dates.

Found the right option? WINGIE gives you a link to complete your booking and payment securely on WINGIE, where the final price is confirmed. No sign-in is needed to search. WINGIE is available in 25 languages with prices in local currencies, and our support team is there for you 24/7.
payload.longDescription:
通过与WINGIE的一次对话规划您的行程。告诉ChatGPT您想去哪里以及何时去，WINGIE将为您搜索航班、酒店和租车的实时价格，让您无需打开数十个标签页即可比较所有选项。

航班：比较300多家航空公司的单程和往返票价，包含时刻表和经停信息。酒店：浏览目的地的酒店，查看您喜欢的酒店的房型、价格、照片和政策。租车：比较不同车型、价格和租还车日期的租赁条款。

找到合适的选项了吗？WINGIE将为您提供安全链接，可在WINGIE上完成预订和支付，最终价格已确认。搜索无需登录。WINGIE支持25种语言，价格以当地货币显示，我们的客服团队将为您提供24/7支持。

payload.name: WhatsDo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WhatsDo turns a conversation about going out into a booking the venue actually receives.

Ask for dinner, a massage, a gym class or somewhere to take a visiting friend, and WhatsDo returns ranked local places with photos, ratings, hours and which of them accept bookings through the app. Where a venue does, the booking is placed in the same conversation. Where it does not, WhatsDo says so and hands over the phone number or the venue's own booking page instead.

What it covers: restaurants, cafes, bars and nightlife, gyms and yoga and other fitness, spas, salons, massage, pet services, hotels, events and activities.

How it books: WhatsDo reaches each venue through whichever rail that venue supports — Square and Mindbody for partnered venues, OpenTable and Yelp for restaurants that use them, the venue's own booking site where one exists, and a WhatsDo team member who completes the request by hand otherwise. Before booking, the app reports which rail applies and what the venue requires, so the details being submitted are visible first.

Confirmation depends on the venue. Some rails confirm inside the conversation; others return a request that stays pending until the venue or the WhatsDo team completes it, and the app reports that status rather than describing a table as held. Cancellation works the same way: it is requested in the conversation and reported as requested until the venue confirms it.

It also knows the signed-in person. Their saved location means they need not name their city; their saved diet, cuisines, price range and vibes shape the ranking; their exclusions keep places they have rejected out of the results. With Google Calendar connected, it can check a proposed time against what they already have on.

WhatsDo currently covers California and Florida.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsDo将关于外出的对话转化为场所实际接收的预订。

当您要求晚餐、按摩、健身课程或接待来访朋友的地点时，WhatsDo会返回经过排序的本地场所信息，包含照片、评分、营业时间以及是否支持通过应用预订。对于支持预订的场所，预订操作会在同一对话中完成；对于不支持的场所，WhatsDo会说明情况并提供电话号码或场所自有预订页面。

覆盖范围包括：餐厅、咖啡馆、酒吧和夜生活场所、健身房和瑜伽馆及其他健身场所、水疗中心、美发沙龙、按摩服务、宠物服务、酒店、活动和赛事。

预订方式：WhatsDo通过场所支持的预订渠道对接每个场所——合作场所使用Square和Mindbody，使用这些平台的餐厅使用OpenTable和Yelp，有自有预订网站的场所则通过该网站，其他情况由WhatsDo团队成员手动完成请求。预订前，应用会显示适用的渠道及场所要求，确保提交的详情可被查看。

确认状态取决于场所。部分渠道可在对话内确认，其他情况会返回待处理请求，直至场所或WhatsDo团队完成操作，应用会显示该状态而非描述为已预留座位。取消操作方式相同：在对话中发起取消并显示为已请求，直至场所确认。

它还能识别登录用户。用户保存的位置意味着无需说明所在城市；用户保存的饮食偏好、菜系、价格范围和氛围偏好会塑造排序结果；用户排除的地点会从结果中过滤。当连接Google日历时，它还能检查拟议时间是否与已有日程冲突。

WhatsDo目前覆盖加利福尼亚州和佛罗里达州。

payload.name: Donde Onde Where
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Donde Onde Where (DOW) publishes monthly-updated Hot Lists of the best-ranked independent restaurants and bars across Portugal and Spain, plus the UK. This plugin puts that index into ChatGPT, so recommendations come from venues that are actually tracked and profiled, each with a link to its full page.

Ask about a city and you get its neighbourhoods, with venue counts and how active each one is. Ask about a neighbourhood and you get its Hot List. The Hot Score is DOW's own momentum measure: it reacts to recent review activity, rating baseline and how complete a venue's profile is. It shows who is gaining attention now, not who is already famous. Ask about a venue by name and you get DOW's verdict: what to book it for, its signature dishes, what it suits, its rating, review count and average spend.

Two further tools cover what is new and what is being noticed. One returns the venues that most recently crossed DOW's editorial threshold in a city. The other reports whether a named venue appears in DOW's own AI-citation probes across several assistants, and states the sample size.

The index is maintained, not scraped once: venue data is collected through the month and the Hot Lists are republished as one edition on the 1st of each month. New venues are added as they qualify. Chains, cafes and bakeries are excluded on purpose. Coverage is specific cities and neighbourhoods, not whole countries, and it grows; ask for the current list.

Everything is read-only. There is no account, no sign-in and no advertising. It returns public venue information only, with no personal data and no individual reviewer identities.

Donde Onde Where is a publication of booteek AI Limited.
payload.longDescription:
Donde Onde Where（DOW）每月更新葡萄牙、西班牙以及英国的最佳独立餐厅和酒吧热门榜单。此插件将该榜单整合至ChatGPT中，因此推荐结果均来自实际被追踪和建档的场所，每个条目都附有其完整页面链接。

询问某个城市可获得其所属区域信息，包含场所数量及各区域活跃度。询问某个区域可获取该区域的热门榜单。DOW的热门评分是其独有的动态指标，会根据近期评论活动、评分基准及场所档案完整性进行调整。它展现的是当前正在获得关注的场所，而非已成名的场所。通过名称询问某个场所可获得DOW的评价：推荐预订理由、招牌菜、适用场景、评分、评论数量及人均消费。

另外两个工具分别覆盖新晋动态和关注度变化。一个工具可返回某城市中最近达到DOW编辑标准的场所列表，另一个工具可报告指定场所是否出现在DOW跨多个助手的AI引文探测中，并说明样本量大小。

该榜单为持续维护数据，而非一次性抓取：场所数据在每月内持续收集，热门榜单每月1日发布单期合集。符合条件的新场所会及时加入。出于刻意选择，连锁店、咖啡馆和面包店不包含在内。覆盖范围限定于特定城市和区域，而非整个国家，且范围持续扩展；可询问当前覆盖列表。

所有信息均为只读模式。无需账户、无需登录、无任何广告。仅返回公共场所信息，不涉及个人数据及评论者身份信息。

Donde Onde Where是booteek AI Limited的出版物。

payload.name: Extreme Wind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Extreme Wind helps kitesurfers, windsurfers, wingfoilers and surfers in Israel decide where and when to go: which beach has wind right now, and which day and spot will be best this week.

It answers from measured data and forecasts, not a web search, for spots along Israel's Mediterranean coast, the Sea of Galilee and Eilat:
- Wind right now at a spot: average, gusts, lulls and direction from the spot's own meter, with when it was measured.
- How the wind behaved over the last hours, in 10-minute steps.
- Which day and hours look best: hour-by-hour wind forecasts up to 5 days from two models, plus a short written summary per spot.
- Wave height, period and direction forecasts, and the latest buoy and beach readings.
- Your saved home wind and wave spots.

Answers name the spot and link to it in the Extreme Wind app.

Sign in with your Extreme Wind account to connect. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot change your settings or alarms, and it never sees your email address or payment details. Disconnect at any time from Settings in Extreme Wind.

Covers spots in Israel only. For your own use; please do not republish the data.

- 当前地点的风况：来自该地点自有气象仪的平均风速、阵风、风力减弱情况及风向，并标注测量时间

- 未来最佳日期和时段：基于两个模型的5天内逐小时风力预测，以及每个地点的简要文字总结
- 波浪高度、周期和方向预测，以及最新的浮标和海滩测量数据

所有答案都会标注具体地点名称，并链接至Extreme Wind应用中的对应页面

使用Extreme Wind账户登录即可连接。

您可随时在Extreme Wind的设置中取消连接

仅覆盖以色列境内的观测点。
仅供个人使用；请勿擅自重新发布数据

payload.name: CarHauler247
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask ChatGPT what it costs to ship your car and get a real answer - not a vague range from a lead-generation site.

CarHauler247 is a licensed auto transport broker (USDOT 3486358, MC 1149762). This app returns the same price you'd get on carhauler247.com. Tell ChatGPT where the vehicle is, where it's going and what it is, and it gets a price for that exact route.

What you get:
- One price. When we can guarantee it, it comes with our Price & Dates Lock: the price and the pickup window are locked when you book. When the lock isn't available (enclosed trailers, non-running vehicles, vans, some smaller towns), you get our starting price, clearly marked as not guaranteed, with the reason.
- The vehicle it priced, so you know what the number is for. Say "2019 RAV4" or just "an SUV" - no trim needed.
- Distance and driving time for the route.
- A booking link that opens carhauler247.com with your route, vehicle and date already filled in, so you can pick your exact trim, review the agreement and book.

Works for cars, SUVs, pickups, vans and minivans - up to 10 on one route, the same or different - on an open carrier or an enclosed trailer, running or not. Covers all 48 continental US states by truck. Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and other US territories need marine transport, which we don't arrange - but we can truck your car to or from the shipping line's port.

No account or sign-in needed. The app only receives the quote details - locations, vehicle, pickup date and options - never your name, contact or payment details, and never your conversation. Nothing is bought or paid in ChatGPT; booking happens on carhauler247.com if you choose.

payload.name: PopUp Surf Trips
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PopUp Surf Trips watches 138 surf spots across the Americas and the Caribbean on a 16-day forecast and matches good surf windows to your own profile: skill level, the biggest wave you are comfortable on, water temperature, home airport and budget.

Ask "Any surf trips lining up for me?" and you get your matched trips best first: a dated surf window that runs as long as the swell lasts, departing 3 to 14 days from now, the spot and country, wave size and rating, a 0-10 Match Score with the reason it matched, a live flight price from your airport, places to stay for those exact dates, and sometimes a guided-surf camp. When the window is longer than the trip you want, it says which day is best so you can pick your own dates inside it. Ask why a trip matched, open one trip in detail, watch a spot so a good window there reaches you, or raise or lower your max wave height.

You sign in with your PopUp Surf Trips account. Booking links open the airline, stay or camp page in your browser; nothing is booked inside ChatGPT. The plugin is a trip builder, not a surf report: it will not guess conditions at a spot it has not matched for you, and it never changes your phone number, email or password.
payload.longDescription:
PopUp Surf Trips 在美洲和加勒比海地区监控138个冲浪点的16天天气预报，并根据您的个人资料匹配合适的冲浪时段：包括冲浪水平、能应对的最大浪高、水温、出发机场和预算。

输入「有适合我的冲浪之旅吗？」，系统将优先展示匹配度最高的行程：包含日期的冲浪时段（持续时间与浪涌周期一致），出发时间距离现在3至14天，具体地点和国家，浪高与评分，0-10分的匹配评分及匹配理由，从您机场出发的实时航班价格，对应日期的住宿信息，有时还包含跟拍冲浪营地。
当可用时段长于您想预订的行程时，系统会标注最佳日期，您可在此时段内自行选择日期。
可询问某行程匹配原因，打开单个行程详情，关注某个冲浪点以便优质浪期通知您，或调整最大浪高阈值。

您需要使用PopUp Surf Trips账户登录。
预订链接会在浏览器中打开航空公司、住宿或营地页面；ChatGPT内不会进行任何预订。
该插件是行程规划工具而非冲浪预报：它不会猜测您未匹配地点的条件，且永远不会修改您的手机号、邮箱或密码。

payload.name: Autonomad
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Autonomad helps you plan and book travel from a conversation.

What you can do:
- Search flights between airports worldwide, with airline, times, stops, cabin, baggage and refundability details, including for parties with children and lap infants.
- Search hotels by city and dates, with nightly and total rates, room options, star ratings, guest scores and cancellation policies.
- Find tours, activities and attractions, plus concerts, sports, theater and other live events.
- Get restaurant suggestions for a city, date and party size.
- Once you have chosen, get one link to autonomad.ai where you review the full price and terms and book the whole trip with one payment. Booked trips can be added to Apple Wallet.
- When you sign in to your Autonomad account: see what changed on your trips since you last checked (schedule changes, confirmations, cancellations and messages), send a question or problem to Autonomad and get the answer in the conversation, and request a cancellation or change to a booking after reviewing a preview and confirming it.

On autonomad.ai you can also plan group trips, where friends plan together and vote on options.

Who it is for: travelers planning trips for themselves, family or friends who want to compare options in a conversation and then book in one place.

Limitations:
- Nothing is booked or paid for in the conversation. Payment, traveler details and identity checks happen on autonomad.ai.
- Restaurant results are for planning only; Autonomad does not make restaurant reservations.
- Prices and availability come from travel suppliers and can change until a booking is completed.
- Some activities and events are shown for information only; results say whether they can be booked.
- Canceling or changing a booking from the conversation works only on trips that include Autonomad's Trip Concierge service; otherwise changes are made in My Trips on autonomad.ai.
- Trip updates, messages and booking changes require signing in to an Autonomad account.
- The account holder who books must be 18 or older; travelers can be any age.
payload.longDescription:
Autonomad通过对话帮你规划并预订旅行

你可以实现以下功能：
- 搜索全球机场间的航班，显示航空公司、时间、经停、舱位、行李和可退款性详情，支持儿童及怀抱婴儿的旅客
- 按城市和日期搜索酒店，显示每晚及总价、房型选项、星级评分、用户评分和取消政策
- 查找旅游项目、活动和景点，以及音乐会、体育赛事、戏剧等现场活动
- 获取城市、日期和人数对应的餐厅推荐
- 选定后可获取autonomad.ai链接，查看完整价格条款并用一次支付完成整段行程预订
已预订行程可添加至Apple Wallet
- 登录Autonomad账户后可查看：自上次查看以来行程的变动（时刻调整、确认信息、取消记录和消息），向Autonomad发送问题并获得对话回复，预览后确认修改或取消预订

在autonomad.ai上还可规划团体行程，朋友可共同规划并投票选择选项

适用对象：希望自行或为家人朋友规划行程的旅行者，可通过对话比较选项并在统一平台完成预订

使用限制：
- 对话中不会进行预订或支付，支付、旅客信息和身份验证均在autonomad.ai完成
- 餐厅推荐仅用于规划参考，Autonomad不提供餐厅预订
- 价格和可用性来自旅行供应商，预订完成前可能发生变化
- 部分活动和赛事仅展示信息，会标注是否可预订
- 通过对话取消或修改预订仅适用于包含Autonomad行程管家服务的行程；其他情况需在autonomad.ai的“我的行程”中操作
- 行程更新、消息和预订修改需要登录Autonomad账户
- 订票账户持有人需年满18岁；旅客年龄无限制

payload.name: Lufthaven
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lufthaven is a flight tracker for iPhone. Connect it and your assistant knows when you are travelling: the flight you are on or about to take, its live status, gate, terminal, delay, the incoming plane and the security wait at departure. When you book a flight, the assistant can save it to Lufthaven so your phone tracks it and alerts you. It reads your saved flights and adds new ones; it cannot remove a flight or change your account. Works with your Lufthaven account on iPhone.
payload.longDescription: Lufthaven是一款适用于iPhone的航班追踪器。连接后，您的助手将了解您的行程：当前乘坐或即将乘坐的航班、实时状态、登机口、航站楼、延误信息、到达航班以及出发时的安全等待时间。预订航班后，助手可将航班信息保存至Lufthaven，您的手机将自动追踪并推送提醒。该应用可读取已保存的航班并自动添加新航班；但无法删除航班或修改您的账户信息。需配合iPhone上的Lufthaven账户使用。

payload.name: Pilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search bookable hotel inventory by place and dates. Results come back with the total price for the stay, photos, guest ratings and map locations.

Narrow by star rating, guest review score, amenities, property type, or distance from a point rather than working through a long list. Open any hotel for its full description, amenity list and address, or pull its room rates to compare board type, cancellation terms and price across the available options.

Booking happens on Pilot. Every result links through to that hotel's page with your dates, occupancy and currency already applied, so the price you were quoted is the price you land on.

No account or sign-in is needed to search.
payload.longDescription:
按地点和日期搜索可预订的酒店库存。搜索结果会显示住宿总价格、照片、客人评分和地图位置。

可通过星级评分、客人评分、设施、房产类型或与特定地点的距离进行筛选，而非逐条浏览长列表。点击任意酒店可查看完整描述、设施清单和地址，或调取房型价格对比膳食类型、取消条款和价格选项。

预订在Pilot上完成。每个搜索结果会跳转至该酒店页面并自动带入您的入住日期、人数和货币单位，因此您看到的报价即为最终价格。

搜索无需账户或登录。

payload.name: Tickets Ibiza
payload.description: 伊比萨岛俱乐部夜场和派对
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tickets Ibiza brings the Tickets Ibiza event calendar into ChatGPT: club nights, pool parties and boat parties across the island, with lineups, start and finish times, venues and the lowest listed ticket price.

Ask what is on, who is playing, or where to go on a given night. You can search by date, venue, DJ, genre, event type or budget, see every Ibiza date for an artist this season, look up a venue and its upcoming nights, or get a night-by-night plan for a trip that matches your music taste, budget and day or night preference. Results can be shown as event cards with an image, date, venue and price.

Each event links to its page on ticketsibiza.com and to the ticket seller listed for it. Tickets Ibiza does not sell tickets inside ChatGPT: purchases happen on the seller's own website. Event pages are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Dutch.

Limitations: the calendar covers Ibiza only. Prices are the lowest price listed when last checked and can change; times are Ibiza local time. Outside the summer season (roughly May to October) there are far fewer upcoming events, but past dates from the current season remain searchable. Venues set their own entry policies, and most clubs are 18+.
payload.longDescription:
Tickets Ibiza将伊比萨岛活动日历引入ChatGPT：涵盖全岛俱乐部夜场、泳池派对和游艇派对，包含阵容、开始和结束时间、场地及最低标价

您可以询问某天的活动内容、演出艺人或前往的地点。可按日期、场地、DJ、音乐类型、活动种类或预算搜索，查看某位艺人本季所有伊比萨演出日期，查询场地及其即将举办的活动，或根据音乐偏好、预算和昼夜时段需求获取逐日行程规划。结果可显示为包含图片、日期、场地和价格的活动卡片

每个活动均链接至ticketsibiza.com的页面及其对应的票务卖家。Tickets Ibiza在ChatGPT内不提供门票销售：购买需前往卖家独立网站。活动页面支持英语、西班牙语、德语、法语、意大利语和荷兰语

限制条件：日历仅覆盖伊比萨岛。价格为最后一次检查时的最低标价，可能随时变动；时间以伊比萨当地时间为准。非夏季（大致为5月至10月）期间活动数量大幅减少，但当前季节的历史日期仍可搜索。场地自行制定入场政策，多数俱乐部要求18岁以上

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Ibiza events, Artist dates, Venue details, Plan nights out, Event cards

payload.name: AllTheStreet
payload.description: 韩国旅行视频中的地点
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AllTheStreet maps YouTube travel videos about Seoul to the places that appear in them. Ask which cafés, restaurants or shops show up in videos about a neighborhood, what places appear in a specific video, or which shops you pass on a walking video — and get the exact timestamp with links to watch from that moment on AllTheStreet or YouTube.

What you get for each place:
- The time it appears in the video, and links that start playback at that moment
- Its name in Japanese and Korean, and in English for most places
- Its category (for example café, restaurant, shopping)
- How many other videos in the collection feature the same place
- A booking link when one is registered — these are affiliate or partner links, and purchases are completed on the partner's website
- A currently running event, when one is registered

Coverage and limits:
- Myeongdong and Jongno in Seoul: about 280 long-form travel videos (mostly by Japanese creators) and 40 first-person walking videos. Coverage will expand over time.
- You can ask in English, Japanese or Korean.
- AllTheStreet does not provide phone numbers, opening hours, prices, ratings or reviews.
- Information comes from AllTheStreet's own mapping of videos to places. Place details, event periods and booking availability can change, so please check with the business or partner before visiting or buying.
- The plugin is read-only: it does not make reservations or payments, does not need an account, and does not ask for your location.
payload.longDescription:
AllTheStreet将关于首尔的YouTube旅行视频与其中出现的地点进行匹配。您可以询问某个街区的视频中出现了哪些咖啡馆、餐厅或商店，特定视频中展示了哪些地点，或步行视频中经过哪些店铺——并获取精确的时间戳，通过AllTheStreet或YouTube链接从此刻开始观看视频。

每个地点提供的信息包括：
— 视频中出现的时间段及可从此处开始播放的链接
— 日文、韩文名称，多数地点提供英文名称
— 所属类别（例如咖啡馆、餐厅、购物场所）
— 同一地点出现在该资料库中其他视频的数量
— 当有注册时提供预订链接——这些为联盟或合作伙伴链接，购买操作将在合作伙伴网站完成
— 当有注册时显示当前进行的活动

覆盖范围与限制：
— 首尔明洞、钟路区：约280个长篇旅行视频（主要由日本创作者制作）和40个第一人称步行视频。
覆盖范围将随时间扩展。
— 支持英文、日文、韩文提问。
— AllTheStreet不提供电话号码、营业时间、价格、评分或评论。
— 信息来源于AllTheStreet自行将视频与地点进行的关联。
地点详情、活动时间及预订可用性可能发生变化，请在到访或购买前直接与商家或合作伙伴确认。
— 该插件为只读模式：不进行预订或支付操作，无需账户，不请求您的位置信息。

payload.name: Railwatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check Amtrak train status, scheduled stops, station arrivals, routes, and direct trips. Railwatch separates published schedules from matched live tracking and explains unavailable or stale data. Open the matching Railwatch page for more detail. No Railwatch account is needed. Railwatch does not sell tickets, send alerts, or access private accounts.
payload.longDescription:
查看美铁列车状态、计划停靠站、车站到站信息、路线及直达行程。
Railwatch会将已发布的时刻表与匹配的实时追踪分开，并解释数据不可用或过时的原因。
打开对应的Railwatch页面以获取更多详情。
无需Railwatch账户。
Railwatch不提供车票销售、发送警报或访问私人账户。

payload.name: SkyAccess
payload.description: 发现私人喷气式飞机的空驶航班
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SkyAccess is a private jet empty leg marketplace with 5,000+ live empty leg flights from 900+ FAA Part 135 (and international equivalent) certified charter operators. Empty legs are one-way repositioning flights that operators offer when an aircraft would otherwise fly without passengers.

With SkyAccess in ChatGPT you can:
- Search current empty leg flights by departure and arrival city or airport, travel dates, number of passengers and an optional maximum price.
- Look up one flight by its ID for its route, departure time, aircraft type, available seats, amenities and listed whole-aircraft price.
- Get the link to a flight's public listing page on skyaccess.com.
- Get an indicative price range for a private charter between two locations, by aircraft category.
- Send a charter request to the SkyAccess team with your name, email and trip details, so a specialist can reply by email.

Listed prices are whole-aircraft prices; taxes and fees are shown at checkout on skyaccess.com. Nothing is purchased or booked in ChatGPT: a charter request takes no payment and creates no booking, and a listing link creates no booking or hold. No SkyAccess account is needed. Inventory changes often, so a flight shown in search can sell before you book it.
payload.longDescription:
SkyAccess是一个私人喷气式飞机空驶航班市场，提供900多家FAA Part 135（及国际等效认证）认证包机运营商的5000+条实时空驶航班信息。空驶航班是航空公司为避免飞机无乘客飞行而提供的单程调机航班。

在ChatGPT中使用SkyAccess，您可以：
- 通过出发城市/机场、到达城市/机场、出行日期、乘客人数和可选最大价格搜索实时空驶航班
- 通过航班ID查询单个航班的航线、起飞时间、飞机型号、可用座位、机上设施及整机价格
- 获取航班在skyaccess.com的公开列表页面链接
- 根据飞机类别获取两点间私人包机的预估价格范围
- 通过填写姓名、邮箱和行程信息向SkyAccess团队发送包机请求，专业人员将通过邮件回复

显示价格为整机价格；税费和费用将在skyaccess.com结账时显示。
在ChatGPT中不会进行任何购买或预订操作：包机请求不涉及付款且不生成预订，列表链接也不会生成预订或预留。
无需SkyAccess账户。
由于库存经常变动，搜索中显示的航班可能在您预订前已售出。

payload.name: Localrydes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search chauffeur vehicle availability for a route and date, compare returned options and prices, create a reservation after confirmation, and check the payment status of an existing booking.

payload.name: Thailand Dive Map

Find and compare Thailand dive shops and liveaboards using public Thailand Dive Map catalogue information. Search by location, language, published course requirements, routes, trip length, reference budget and other supported filters. Open selected profiles for courses, cabins, itineraries, inclusions, prerequisites and source links where available.

Results preserve missing information and source dates. Operating months describe seasonal catalogue data, not live departures or availability. Prices are published reference values, not current total quotes.

The plugin reads public information. It does not access private owner or customer records, contact operators, send enquiries, certify safety, decide diver eligibility, place bookings or take payments. Confirm operational details, availability and final prices directly with the operator.
payload.longDescription:
通过公共泰国潜水地图目录信息查找和比较泰国潜水店与潜水船。按地点、语言、已发布课程要求、路线、行程时长、参考预算及其他支持的筛选条件进行搜索。打开选定资料页查看课程、舱房、行程安排、包含项目、先修条件及来源链接（如适用）

搜索结果保留缺失信息和数据来源日期。运营月份描述的是季节性目录数据，而非实时出发信息或可用性。价格为已发布参考值，非当前最终报价

该插件仅读取公开信息，不访问私人所有者或客户记录，不联系运营商、发送咨询、认证安全性、决定潜水员资格、安排预订或处理支付。请直接与运营商确认运营细节、可用性及最终价格

payload.name: Jade Beach Hotel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A personal hotel concierge for Jade Beach Hotel in ChatGPT. Search current room availability with total prices, discover hotel experiences, compare one or several date ranges, and ask questions answered from hotel-provided information. Assemble a selected room and activities into one bookable offer. The plugin is limited to Jade Beach Hotel. It prepares a checkout link but does not complete payment inside ChatGPT; guests review details and pay on the linked hotel or Turneo checkout page.
payload.longDescription:
Jade Beach Hotel 的专属酒店礼宾服务，集成于 ChatGPT。
可查询当前房间可用情况及总价，发现酒店体验，比较一个或多个日期范围，并向酒店提供的信息提问。
将选定的房间和活动组合成一个可预订的套餐。

payload.name: 333travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zoek rondreizen, bestemmingsinformatie en reisinformatie van 333travel.
payload.longDescription: 搜索333travel的环游行程、目的地信息和旅行资讯。

payload.name: Nantes IA par Infotan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find information about the Naolib network in Nantes directly in ChatGPT: stops, routes, upcoming departures and reported service disruptions.
Search for a stop by name or find stops near a location you specify, with their serving routes and approximate straight-line distances. Then ask for upcoming departures in your chosen direction. You can also plan a journey on a single route for a specific date: check published scheduled times to leave within a time window or reach a stop before your preferred arrival time. Check reported disruptions affecting a route or the whole network, including current and upcoming alerts or alerts for a specific date.
Responses use Infotan data and include links to timetables and disruption details.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接获取南特的Naolib网络信息：站点、路线、即将发生的发车信息和已报告的服务中断情况。通过名称搜索站点，或查找您指定位置附近的站点，包括其服务路线和大致直线距离。然后查询您选择方向的后续发车信息。您还可以为特定日期规划单一路线的行程：查看已发布的时刻表时间，确认是否能在时间窗口内出发或在您偏好的到达时间前抵达某个站点。查看影响某条路线或整个网络的已报告中断情况，包括当前和未来的警报信息或特定日期的警报信息。响应内容使用Infotan数据，并包含时刻表和中断详情的链接。

Get location details, nearby results, last-reported availability, existing thumbnail previews and links to the original viewer. payload.longDescription: 搜索公共风景、动物、交通和机场网络摄像头。获取位置详情、附近结果、最后报告的可用性、现有缩略图预览及原始观看器的链接。缩略图并非实时捕捉画面；拍摄时间可能未知。无私人摄像头访问、写入或嵌入式视频播放。

payload.name: Taiwan Weather Lens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: An unofficial tool using Central Weather Administration data for Taiwan township forecasts, stations within a requested district, and comparison of 2–4 specified weather windows. Forecasts provide hourly detail within today and the next two Taipei dates, or a seven-date outlook in native 12-hour day/night periods with temperature ranges and data gaps. Rain probabilities follow actual source intervals and coverage, which may be shorter than seven days; no seven-day hourly rain forecast is invented. Short-window comparison remains within three dates: the backend aligns samples and original rain intervals, reports coverage and missing data, and returns rule-based differences or refusal reasons, never an overall best window. Requires a county/city and township/district. Stations are sorted by name, not distance; no district station means no data. Official, retrieval and query times remain distinct. Missing values stay missing. Data may be delayed or incomplete; stations do not represent your home or the whole district. No safety guarantee: consult official warnings and local conditions for high-risk activities. No mountain, radar, history, travel or calendar tools.
payload.longDescription:
一款非官方工具，使用中央气象局数据提供台湾乡镇预报、指定区域内的气象站信息，以及2-4个指定天气时段的对比。
预报包含今日及接下来两个台北日期的逐小时详情，或本地12小时昼夜周期的七日展望，包含温度范围和数据缺口。
降雨概率遵循原始数据源的时段和覆盖范围，可能短于七天；不会虚构七日逐小时降雨预报。
短时段对比限定在三个日期内：后端会对齐样本与原始降雨时段，报告覆盖情况和缺失数据，并返回基于规则的差异说明或拒绝原因，不会给出整体最优时段。
需要县/市和乡镇/区。
气象站按名称排序，而非距离；无区域站点即无数据。
官方数据、检索时间和查询时间相互独立。
缺失值保持缺失。
数据可能延迟或不完整；气象站不代表您的住所或整个区域。
不提供安全保证：高风险活动请咨询官方预警和当地情况。
无山地、雷达、历史、旅行或日历工具。

payload.name: TeamOut
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Start planning a company offsite or team retreat by finding places to stay and meet. Browse and compare TeamOut's public venue catalog, including lodging capacity, meeting facilities, amenities, and accommodation estimates. Dates, group size, and budget are optional for initial discovery. Availability is not confirmed, and the plugin does not book venues or request quotes.
payload.longDescription: 通过寻找住宿和会议场所来规划公司外出活动或团队团建。浏览并对比TeamOut的公开场地目录，包含住宿容量、会议设施、配套设施及住宿费用预估。日期、团队规模和预算在初始探索阶段为可选条件。可用性未确认，该插件不负责预订场地或请求报价。

payload.name: Hotel Please
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hotel Please is an atlas of the world's most notable hotels: luxury hotels, boutique and design hotels, resorts and heritage hotels. Every hotel is researched and profiled one at a time, and none can pay to be included or to earn a medal.

Ask where to stay and ChatGPT answers from our profiles with hotel recommendations for a city, country or neighborhood, ranked by our medals, with why each one stands out. Narrow by vibe (design, luxury, heritage, wellness, resort, local, social, classic), by a pool, gym or spa, by Michelin Keys or by price. Ask about one hotel and ChatGPT gets its full profile: the rooms, pool and spa, restaurants and bars, history, neighborhood, honours and a typical nightly price.

Every hotel links to its profile on hotelplease.app, opens in the Hotel Please app if you have it, and comes with links to book. Some booking links earn Hotel Please a commission at no cost to you; commissions never decide which hotels are included or how they are rated.

The plugin is read-only and needs no account. It receives only the place, hotel and filters in each request, never your conversation.
payload.longDescription:
Hotel Please 是一本记录全球著名酒店的图册，涵盖豪华酒店、精品设计酒店、度假村和历史遗产酒店。每家酒店都单独进行研究和介绍，且没有任何酒店可以付费加入或获取奖章。

询问住宿地点时，ChatGPT 会根据我们的资料提供城市、国家或社区的酒店推荐，按奖章等级排序，并说明每家酒店的特色。可按氛围（设计、豪华、遗产、健康、度假、本地、社交、经典）、是否有泳池/健身房/水疗中心、米其林钥匙等级或价格进行筛选。询问某家酒店时，ChatGPT 会展示其完整资料：房间、泳池和水疗中心、餐厅和酒吧、历史背景、周边环境、获得的荣誉以及典型每晚价格。

每家酒店均链接至 hotelplease.app 的简介页面，若您安装了 Hotel Please 应用程序将直接打开，并附有预订链接。部分预订链接会为 Hotel Please 产生佣金，但不会增加您的任何成本；佣金不会影响酒店的入选资格或评分。

该插件为只读模式，无需账户即可使用。每次请求仅接收地点、酒店和筛选条件信息，不会保存您的对话内容。

payload.name: FlyEthio

No FlyEthio account or sign-in is needed.

payload.name: Compi

payload.summaryOriginal: Your trip, ready on the road

Compi turns the trip you plan with ChatGPT into a travel companion you can use on the road.

Ask ChatGPT to save your trip to Compi, and it creates days, places, stays, drives and lists in your Compi account. Later you can ask what is on the plan for a day, add or move activities, or check the trip for gaps such as nights without a stay, open bookings, long drive days or missing entry permits.

In the Compi web app you then have today's plan with the next step and navigation, a map with drive times, your stays, packing and shopping lists, a shared trip kitty and a recap after the trip. Your trip stays readable offline.

payload.name: Uptown101

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Swiss Activities is a travel app for Switzerland. Plan trips, day trips and leisure time with live data:

• Trains and public transport: timetables for trains, buses, trams, boats, cable cars and mountain railways across Switzerland, with lines, platforms and transfers, and links to buy train tickets.

• Attractions: Jungfraujoch, Titlis, Pilatus, Rigi, Rhine Falls and more than 300 other excursion destinations with operating hours and tickets.
• Activities and tickets: more than 3,200 bookable excursions, tours, scenic trains, mountain railway and lake cruise tickets and adventure sports, with live availability, start times and prices for your group.
• Places and opening hours: museums, zoos, playgrounds, public pools and lakes, viewpoints, mountain huts and local events, with opening hours, admission and address.
• Hiking: official Swiss hiking trails with walking time, distance, ascent, trail class, public-transport stops and live closures, plus theme trails for families and winter routes.
• Weather: MeteoSwiss forecasts for the next 7 days and official weather warnings.
• Maps in the chat: results on a swisstopo map with photos, prices and booking links, trails with their route and elevation profile, train connections with their route, and the rail pass comparison side by side.

Covers all of Switzerland, including Zurich, Lucerne, Interlaken, Grindelwald, Zermatt, the Jungfrau region, Geneva, Lausanne, Lugano and St. Moritz. Works in English, German, French, Italian and 26 more languages. Bookings are completed on swissactivities.com.
payload.longDescription:
Swiss Activities 是一款针对瑞士的旅行应用，提供实时数据帮助规划行程、短途旅行和休闲活动：

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search flights worldwide with Alice, an Israeli travel provider, and book on alice.co.il. Just ask for a route: Tel Aviv to New York, Paris to Tokyo, a weekend in Rome. 通过以色列旅行服务商Alice搜索全球航班，并在alice.co.il预订。只需提供行程需求：特拉维夫至纽约、巴黎至东京、罗马周末游等。每趟航班都会标注最佳、最便宜或最快选项，清晰展示不同选择的权衡。覆盖范围最深的是以色列境内及来往以色列的航班，包含特拉维夫（TLV）及所有以色列机场。用希伯来语提问将获得希伯来语的搜索结果，呈现从右到左的阅读方向。

Alice仅提供搜索服务。不会代为预订、支付或更改航班信息，且无需创建账户或登录。

payload.name: Stayspan Schengen Days
payload.description: 统计并规划申根签证停留天数
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan Schengen short stays with a rolling 90/180 rule calculator and a daily CSV download. Stayspan Schengen Days counts entry and exit dates, reports days used and days left, identifies overstay dates and checks proposed consecutive trips.

Use the interactive calendar to inspect a date, add or remove stays and recalculate. Trip planning returns the maximum stay from your entry date, the last exit that meets the rule and an entry date that supports your requested length. Reset projections show how window headroom returns over the next 180 days, assuming no further visits. Window headroom can differ from maximum consecutive stay.

For example, check a visit from January 1 through March 31, 2026 as of March 31, 2026, or plan a 30-day trip from July 1, 2026 after that visit. Accepts ISO dates and US text dates such as March 5, 2026. Shared exit/entry dates merge and count once; other overlaps are refused. Open stays end at the check date.

Short stays only. Calculation aid, not legal advice; a border officer makes the decision. Bilateral agreements, special visa-waiver rules, residence permits and long-stay visas are not included. Check visa validity, permitted entries and any shorter visa-sticker allowance separately. Up to 60 stays spanning 1,100 days, years 1900–2100. Enter only applicable days in the Schengen area; historical country membership is not inferred.
payload.longDescription:
使用滚动90/180天规则计算器和每日CSV下载功能规划申根短期停留。Stayspan申根天数工具会统计进出日期，显示已使用天数和剩余天数，识别超期停留日期并验证连续行程计划。

通过交互式日历查看日期、添加或移除停留记录并重新计算。行程规划将返回从您的入境日期开始的最大停留时间、符合规则的最晚离境日期以及支持您要求时长的入境日期。重置预测显示未来180天内可用窗口期的剩余空间（假设不再有其他访问）。窗口期剩余空间可能与最大连续停留时间不同。

例如：以2026年3月31日为基准，核查2026年1月1日至3月31日的停留记录，或在该停留后规划2026年7月1日开始的30天行程。支持ISO格式日期和美国文本日期（如2026年3月5日）。共享的进出日期仅计算一次；其他重叠情况将被拒绝。未完成的停留截至核查日期结束。

仅适用于短期停留。本工具为计算辅助，不构成法律建议；最终决定权在边境检查官。不包含双边协议、特殊免签规则、居留许可和长期签证。需单独核查签证有效性、允许入境次数及任何较短的签证贴纸限制。最多支持60次停留，总计1100天，年份范围1900–2100。仅需输入申根区实际停留天数；不推断历史国家成员身份。

payload.name: Rental Blacklist
payload.description: 检查租赁房源是否存在红色警报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rental Blacklist is a community map of rental problems: tenants report bad-faith landlords, scams, hidden defects and other issues, and moderators approve the reports before they are published.

Use it before renting a flat or house:
- search reports by address (street + house number works best; addresses are mostly in Russian),
- search around coordinates when you know where the place is,
- open a report to see what happened, its severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical), date, photos and a link that opens it on the map,
- read the project's news.

All tools are read-only and expose only what is already public on rentalredflags.com; no account is needed. Reports are accounts from other tenants, not verified facts, and finding nothing only means nobody has reported the place yet. Coverage is strongest in Russia and CIS countries.
payload.longDescription:
Rental Blacklist 是一个租赁问题社区地图：租客可举报不良房东、诈骗行为、隐藏缺陷等各类问题，经版主审核后才会发布。

租前使用方法：
- 通过地址搜索（街道加门牌号效果最佳；地址多为俄语格式），
- 已知具体位置时可通过坐标搜索，
- 打开报告查看事件详情，包含严重程度（低/中/高/严重）、日期、照片以及跳转至地图的链接，
- 阅读项目最新动态。

所有工具均为只读模式，仅展示租赁红黑榜网站已公开信息；无需账号即可使用。
报告内容来自其他租客的主观陈述，并非官方核实信息，未找到记录仅表示暂无人举报该房源。
服务覆盖范围在俄罗斯及独联体国家最为完善。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search rental reports by address, Find reports near coordinates, Read report details, photos and map link, Read project news

payload.name: Table12
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Table12 is a table booking network for restaurants, hotels, spas and activities. Ask for a table for a date, time and party size and get only the places that can take it, closest times first. Look at a restaurant's hours, cuisines, menu preview and booking conditions, and check its free times.

Signing in to your Table12 account lets you book a table, see your reservations, change a request that is still waiting, or withdraw it. Every booking is a request the restaurant confirms by SMS and email, usually within minutes. Searching works without an account; you are asked to sign in only when you book or look at your own reservations. Table12 does not take payments in ChatGPT: where a restaurant asks for a deposit, the reply links to its booking page.
payload.longDescription:
Table12是面向餐厅、酒店、水疗中心和活动的餐桌预订网络。
输入日期、时间及人数，系统将优先显示可预订的最近时段的场所。
查看餐厅营业时间、菜系类型、菜单预览和预订条件，并查询其空闲时段。

登录Table12账户后，您可以预订餐桌、查看预订记录、修改待处理的请求或取消预订。
每笔预订均为待确认请求，餐厅会通过短信和邮件确认，通常在几分钟内完成。
搜索功能无需账户即可使用；仅在预订或查看个人预订记录时需要登录。
Table12不处理ChatGPT支付：当餐厅要求预付定金时，回复将跳转至其预订页面。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find a free table, Search restaurants, Restaurant details and menus, Check availability, Book a table, Manage your reservations

payload.name: WIZZ Link flight search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search flights across the WIZZ network, compare indicative fares across a month, and review flight offers with a link to the partner fare page. Travellers can continue there or manage a flight on WIZZ Link. The app does not book or change flights itself.
payload.longDescription: 在WIZZ网络中搜索航班，比较一个月内的参考票价，并通过链接跳转至合作伙伴的票价页面查看航班优惠。旅客可在此页面继续操作或在WIZZ Link上管理航班。该应用本身不进行航班预订或更改。

payload.name: GdeNaMore smeštaj
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search active GdeNaMore accommodation by destination, type, amenities, dates and indicative price. Compare property and unit cards, browse photos and videos, and open listing presentations or phone contacts on GdeNaMore. To contact an owner through ChatGPT, provide your first and last name, email, phone number and message, review the prepared inquiry, and explicitly confirm before it is sent. Prices and availability must be confirmed with the owner.

payload.name: TodayNYC
payload.description: 纽约市3小时行程与周末版
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use two focused TodayNYC experiences backed by the same curated product data and presented with an interactive inline map when the host supports MCP Apps UI. Build up to three complete 180-minute Manhattan microplans with three curated stops, selectable alternatives on one map, canonical identifiers, published hours, short catalog walks, and reviewed historical and cultural context along the approximate route. Or read the current citywide weekend edition with independently mapped events, weather, important city notices, mobility impacts, freshness and official sources. TodayNYC covers 19 walkable Manhattan microzones for the three-hour planner and publishes a separate weekly NYC briefing. TodayNYC itself does not check live availability, open external sites, make reservations, sell tickets, prepare transactions or process payments. Any later browsing or transaction assistance chosen by ChatGPT is outside TodayNYC and must not be presented as a TodayNYC capability or action.
payload.longDescription:
当主机支持MCP Apps UI时，可通过相同的精选产品数据，以交互式内联地图呈现两个专注的TodayNYC体验。
构建最多三个完整的180分钟曼哈顿微型行程，包含三个精选站点、单张地图上的可选替代方案、标准标识符、公开营业时间、简短目录导览，以及沿大致路线的已审核历史和文化背景信息。
或阅读当前全市周末特刊，包含独立标注的活动地图、天气信息、重要城市通知、交通影响、新鲜度及官方信息来源。
TodayNYC覆盖3小时规划的19个步行可达曼哈顿微区域，并发布独立的每周纽约简报。
TodayNYC本身不检查实时可用性、打开外部网站、预订、售 ticket、处理交易或支付流程。
由ChatGPT选择的后续浏览或交易协助属于TodayNYC之外的功能，不得被呈现为TodayNYC的能力或操作。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate curated three-hour Manhattan plan options, Resolve a neighborhood, station or known New York place, Read the current curated NYC weekend edition, Summarize weekend weather, city notices and mobility impacts, Expose canonical plan identifiers and published source links, Add attributed historical, architectural and cultural route context, Show interactive route and weekend-highlight maps inline in the conversation, Explain freshness and coverage limitations, Explain TodayNYC's read-only booking, ticketing and live-availability limits

payload.name: PakBus
payload.description: 巴基斯坦公交路线及时间
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PakBus helps you travel by public bus and metro in Pakistani cities such as Lahore, Karachi, Multan, Rawalpindi and Islamabad.

Ask for a journey between two places and PakBus gives the bus to take, where to board, where to change or get off, the times and the fare, with a map of the route. You can also see the next departures from a stop, the stops and timetable of a route, the cities covered and current service changes such as closed stations.

Times come from published timetables and a travel-time model, not from tracking buses. Women-only routes are listed but not used for journeys. PakBus covers city bus and metro routes only, not intercity coaches, trains or ticket booking.

PakBus is independent. It is not run by any government body or bus operator.
payload.longDescription:
PakBus帮助您在拉合尔、卡拉奇、木尔坦、拉瓦尔品第和伊斯兰堡等巴基斯坦城市中通过公共交通出行。

输入两个地点之间的行程请求，PakBus将提供需乘坐的公交、上下车地点、换乘或下车地点、时间及票价，并附有路线地图。您还可以查看某站点的下一班发车信息、某条路线的站点及时刻表、覆盖城市以及当前服务变动信息（如车站关闭情况）。

时刻表信息来源于公开的时刻表和行程时间模型，并非通过追踪公交获取。女性专用车辆路线会列出，但不会用于行程规划。PakBus仅覆盖城市公交和地铁路线，不包括跨城市长途巴士、火车或票务预订。

PakBus为独立平台，未由任何政府机构或公交运营商运营。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan bus and metro journeys with a map, Show the next departures from a stop, Show a route's stops, fare and timetable, List service changes such as closed stations

payload.name: Nemo Places
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nemo Places is a small app for saving the places you love and sharing a live map of them. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your saved places: find what is near, add a place from a Maps link or a name, tidy duplicates, move places between categories and shared maps, mark visits, and move places to Recently deleted and back. It works with the signed-in account's own places; shared maps are read as anyone with the link sees them. Deleted places are kept in Recently deleted for 30 days, on every device and in ChatGPT, and can be restored from there until they are removed.
payload.longDescription: Nemo Places是一款小型应用，用于保存你喜爱的地点并分享实时地图。此插件可让ChatGPT操作你的收藏地点：查找附近地点、通过地图链接或名称添加地点、整理重复项、在不同分类和共享地图间移动地点、标记访问记录，并可将地点移至最近删除并恢复。该功能仅针对已登录账号的个人地点；共享地图的内容对任何拥有链接的人都可见。已删除地点将在最近删除中保留30天，所有设备及ChatGPT中均可恢复，直至被彻底移除。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find places, Add places, Edit places, Merge duplicates, Shared maps, Recently deleted

payload.name: Events.lc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Events.lc looks up the events listed on its ticketing and event platform, starting with Malta at events.com.mt (Events.mt): search by words, dates or town, open an event to see its programme, start and end times (Malta local time), venue with address and map position, organiser, and the kinds of ticket with their prices, and check whether tickets are still on sale and how many places are left. You can also list the venues events are held at.

Everything the app shows is already public on events.com.mt, and no account is needed. It does not sell tickets: each result links to the event's page on events.com.mt, where tickets are bought from the organiser. Events by invitation appear only when their organiser lists them publicly; they are marked as such and cannot be booked without an invitation.
payload.longDescription:
Events.lc会查询其票务和活动平台上的活动信息，首先展示马耳他地区events.com.mt（Events.mt）的活动：可通过关键词、日期或城镇搜索，打开活动查看节目安排、开始和结束时间（马耳他当地时间）、包含地址和地图位置的举办场地、主办方信息，以及各类票种及其价格，并可查看门票是否在售及剩余席位数量。您也可以查看活动举办的场地列表。

应用显示的所有内容已在events.com.mt公开，无需账户即可使用。该应用不销售门票：每个搜索结果都会链接至events.com.mt上的活动页面，门票需通过主办方购买。邀请制活动仅在主办方公开列出时显示，此类活动会特别标注，且没有邀请函无法进行预订。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search events, Read event details, Check ticket availability, List venues

payload.name: Evntally
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up upcoming events in covered cities across the United States and Canada, from neighborhood listings to large shows. Evntally returns the date, venue, price, and a link to the public event page. It does not sell tickets, collect an email address, or start an account.
payload.longDescription:
查找美国和加拿大覆盖城市中的即将举行的活动，从社区活动列表到大型演出。
Evntally会提供活动日期、场地、价格以及公开活动页面的链接。
它不销售门票、收集电子邮件地址或创建账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search events, Read event details, List covered cities

payload.name: Sidequest
payload.description: 与您的AI一起规划儿童活动
payload.summaryOriginal: Plan kid outings with your AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sidequest helps parents plan kid outings. Connect your Sidequest account, then ask about your saved Sidequests, crew ages and preferences (never allergies or health notes), family memories, your Sidequest calendar, and local kid-friendly events. With your explicit yes, it can add a calendar entry, mark a Sidequest complete, or build a new outing from a short request. Everything runs under your signed-in parent account and only sees your own household. Sharing, invites, and deletes stay in the Sidequest app.
payload.longDescription:
Sidequest帮助家长规划儿童活动。
连接您的Sidequest账户后，可以询问已保存的Sidequest、团队成员年龄和偏好（不会涉及过敏或健康信息）、家庭回忆、Sidequest日历以及当地的儿童友好活动。
在获得您的明确同意后，它可以添加日历条目、标记Sidequest为完成，或根据简短请求创建新的活动。
所有操作均在您登录的家长账户下进行，仅访问您自己的家庭数据。
分享、邀请和删除操作均在Sidequest应用内完成。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List saved Sidequests, Read crew ages and preferences, Check the family calendar, Discover local kid events, Add calendar entries after you confirm

payload.name: HomeBase Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Help new hires relocating to Dallas, Houston and Austin compare neighborhoods, read approved relocation answers and guides, and find apartments by budget. Employer, exact office and days in the office guide commute discussions. Starting rents are stored references, not live availability. This read-only connection does not book tours, process payments, submit applications or access customer records.
payload.longDescription: 帮助即将迁往达拉斯、休斯顿和奥斯汀的新员工比较不同社区，阅读经批准的搬迁问答和指南，并根据预算寻找公寓。雇主、具体办公地点及在办公室的天数将指导通勤讨论。起始租金为存储的参考信息，非实时可租状态。此只读连接无法预订看房、处理付款、提交申请或访问客户记录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find apartments, Open search links, Search approved knowledge, Read guides

payload.name: Domus Aedes
payload.description: 西班牙和摩洛哥的房源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe what you are looking for — a villa to buy on the Costa del Sol, a long-term rental in Nueva Andalucía, a week in Marrakech or on the Catalan coast — and Domus Aedes returns the best matches from its own portfolio, up to six at a time, with photos, prices, key facts and a map. Ask for more and it narrows the search with you rather than listing pages of results. Open full details, check live availability for stays (when our own stays are fully booked, it points you to the Domus Aedes concierge), and send your contact details to a Domus Aedes advisor without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: 描述您的需求——在阳光海岸购买别墅、在新安达卢西亚长期租赁、在马拉喀什或加泰罗尼亚海岸度假一周——Domus Aedes将从其自有房源组合中返回最佳匹配结果，每次最多展示六条，附带照片、价格、关键信息和地图。要求进一步筛选时，它会与您共同缩小搜索范围，而非列出多页结果。打开完整详情页，查看住宿实时可预订状态（当我们的自营住宿已满时，会引导至Domus Aedes管家服务），并无需离开聊天界面即可将联系方式发送给Domus Aedes顾问。

payload.name: Remap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Remap generates routes for cycling, running and walking anywhere on Earth.

Tell Remap how long you’ve got and it generates a fresh route from where you are, through beautiful places you’ve never explored.

It knows the roads and trails around you better than anyone possibly could. The routes are generated on your device and appear within seconds. Ask in the chat if you want the route to be shorter, longer or hillier. Or what kind of scenery you want more of. Then tap Ride, Run or Walk on a route to open it in the Remap app.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generates cycling, running and walking routes, Starts from a place or your location, Shows routes on a map with their stories, Opens a route in the Remap app

payload.name: RentalCal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RentalCal powers the booking sites of independent vacation-rental hosts. Give ChatGPT a host's booking site address (an address ending in rentalcal.com, or the host's own domain) and it can describe the property, show which dates are open, and price a stay exactly, including cleaning fees, taxes and any weekly or monthly discount.

When you are ready to book, you get a link to the host's own booking page with your dates and party size already filled in. You review the stay and pay there, directly with the host, with no platform service fee.

Limitations: you need the host's booking site address, since searching across all RentalCal properties is not available yet. ChatGPT cannot place or change a booking for you.
payload.longDescription:
RentalCal为独立度假租赁房东的预订网站提供支持。将房东的预订网站地址（以rentalcal.com结尾的地址，或房东的自有域名）提供给ChatGPT，它能够描述房源信息，展示可预订日期，并精确计算住宿费用，包括清洁费、税费以及任何周租或月租折扣。

确认预订时，您将获得跳转至房东自有预订页面的链接，其中已自动填写日期和入住人数。您可在该页面审核住宿信息并直接向房东支付，无需支付平台服务费。

限制：您需要获取房东的预订网站地址，目前尚不支持跨所有RentalCal房源的搜索功能。ChatGPT无法代您下单或修改预订。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up a vacation rental by its booking site, Show open dates and minimum stays, Price a stay with fees, taxes and discounts, Link to the host's booking page with dates filled in

payload.name: Obi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Obi compares ride prices across taxi and rideshare providers so you can pick the cheapest or fastest option for any trip. Ask for a ride between two places and Obi shows the available offers with price, service level and estimated pickup time, and links you straight to the provider app. Obi can also book an Uber or Lyft offer for you, after you confirm, through the provider account linked in the Obi app. You can ask for a specific type of car, such as Economy, XL, a premium ride or a wheelchair accessible vehicle. Obi also finds places near you, like restaurants, pharmacies or cafes, and shows public transit routes with each leg and its duration.
payload.longDescription: Obi可在出租车和拼车服务提供商之间比较乘车价格，让您为任何行程选择最便宜或最快的选项。在两个地点间叫车时，Obi会显示包含价格、服务等级和预计到达时间的可用服务，并直接跳转至服务商应用。确认后，Obi还可通过Obi应用中绑定的服务商账户为您预订Uber或Lyft服务。您可指定特定车型，例如经济型、大型车、豪华车或无障碍车辆。Obi还能查找附近的地点，如餐厅、药店或咖啡馆，并显示包含每个路段及持续时间的公共交通路线。

payload.name: Destiny Blue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Destiny Blue is a fully agentic, full-duplex AI travel concierge. Guests can plan a trip through natural conversation: search live stays and prices, explore flights and rental cars, compare options, adjust dates and budgets, check weather and tides, discover things to do, and book. Destiny draws on live tools and deep travel knowledge to keep adapting the plan as the conversation unfolds. Today, Destiny helps guests explore Destin Condo Getaways' Gulf-front condos at Pelican Beach Resort in Destin, Florida. Booking is completed on the website; prices and availability may change before checkout.
payload.longDescription: Destiny Blue是一款全自主、全双工的AI旅行管家。客人可通过自然对话规划行程：实时搜索住宿和价格，探索航班和租车选项，比较不同方案，调整日期和预算，查看天气和潮汐信息，发现当地活动并完成预订。Destiny依托实时工具和深厚的旅行知识，在对话过程中持续优化行程方案。目前，Destiny帮助客人探索佛罗里达州迪斯廷市Pelican Beach Resort的迪斯廷公寓度假屋。预订需在网站完成，价格和可用性可能在结账前发生变化。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan and adapt a trip through natural conversation, Search live stays, availability, and prices, Explore flight and rental-car options, Compare travel options and adjust dates or budgets, Check live weather, temperatures, and tides, Discover activities and local recommendations, Book a chosen stay with dates and guests in place

payload.name: hoteldiscount24 Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
What it does: find hotels at a destination that offer specific amenities (around 150 features, e.g. pool, sauna, billiards, pets allowed); look up the amenity profile of an individual hotel, by its hoteldiscount24.com link or by name and place; get typical nightly price ranges for a destination and month.

Where the data comes from: amenities as stated by the hotels; price ranges measured from recent searches, each with its date.

Limits: no live prices, no availability, no ratings, no booking - prices, availability and booking are on hoteldiscount24.com, and every result carries a link there. Halal, kosher, wheelchair access, non-smoking and cribs are shown per hotel as stated by the hotel, never used as search filters.

Intended users: travellers planning a stay. Not for booking or comparing prices for specific dates.

Privacy: read-only, no account needed, no personal data is sent.

payload.name: TravelYalla
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TravelYalla finds live flight and hotel prices inside your chat, for trips across Egypt, Saudi Arabia and worldwide.

Search one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights and compare them by price, stops, airline, departure time and baggage. Search hotels by city or hotel name and narrow them by star rating, guest score, price and distance from the city centre. Plan a whole trip with flights and a matching stay in one currency, or find the cheapest day to fly within a date range.

Ask in English or Arabic. Prices follow your nationality and currency, and every result links straight to travelyalla.com to book.
payload.longDescription:
TravelYalla 在您的聊天中实时显示航班和酒店价格，适用于埃及、沙特阿拉伯及全球其他目的地的行程。

搜索单程、往返和多城市航班，并通过价格、经停次数、航空公司、出发时间和行李进行比较。按城市或酒店名称搜索酒店，并通过星级评分、用户评分、价格和市中心距离进行筛选。在单一货币中规划包含航班和住宿的完整行程，或查找日期范围内最便宜的飞行日期。

支持英文或阿拉伯语咨询。价格会根据您的国籍和货币显示，所有结果均直接链接至 travelyalla.com 进行预订。

payload.name: Retreat & Be Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare offers for your stay.
payload.longDescription: 比较您的住宿报价

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search hotel destinations, Compare hotel offers, Read room conditions

payload.name: WAYA flight search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search WAYA flights, compare indicative fares across a month, and review flight offers with a link to the partner fare page. Travellers can continue there or manage a flight on WAYA. The app does not book or change flights itself.
payload.longDescription: 搜索WAYA航班，比较一个月内的参考票价，并通过链接查看合作伙伴的票价页面。旅客可以继续在该页面操作或在WAYA上管理航班。该应用本身不进行航班预订或更改。

payload.name: hoper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
hoper is a helicopter travel marketplace for private and shared flights in Greece, France, Switzerland and Italy: Athens and the Greek islands, the French Alps and the Riviera, Geneva, Zurich and Zermatt, Milan, Rome and Sardinia.

Ask ChatGPT about a helicopter trip, for example "Can I fly from Athens to Anafi?" or "Which helicopters fly Geneva to Courchevel next Tuesday?". The hoper app tells you:

- if hoper flies the route, as a private flight, a shared flight or both
- the distance in nautical miles

payload.name: Smart Chess:Train+Learn to win
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play chess without leaving ChatGPT. Start a new game in seconds, make moves in normal chess language, and talk about every part of the game as you play. You can ask why a move is good, why a move is bad, what to do next, or how to get better. This app is made for people who want to play, learn, and have fun at the same time.

The app is easy to use. Just begin a game and make your moves. You can use simple move names, standard chess notation, or ask questions in plain English. If you are not sure what to do, ask for help. The game keeps going while you chat, so learning feels natural instead of like reading a long lesson.

If you are brand new to chess, this app is a friendly place to start. It explains ideas in small, simple steps. It tells you what each piece can do and why some moves are stronger than others. You never have to pretend you understand. Just ask another question. You can learn one move at a time.

If you already know how to play, you can go deeper. Talk about openings, middle games, endgames, tactics, strategy, planning, and common mistakes. Ask why a position feels better for one side. Compare different moves. Explore new ideas. The conversation changes to fit your questions.

Play at your own speed. Think for a long time or move quickly. Stop to ask about a position. Go back and look at an earlier move. Try a different idea and see what could happen. Chess is not only about finding the best move. It is also about understanding why that move works.

The app can explain forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, double checks, sacrifices, passed pawns, king safety, piece activity, space, time, and many other chess ideas using clear language. Hard topics become easier because you can ask for another explanation whenever you need one.

Want to improve? Review your games after they finish. Talk about turning points, missed chances, and strong moves. Ask where the game changed. Find patterns in your play. Learn from mistakes instead of simply seeing that they happened. Every game becomes a chance to get stronger.

You can also practice specific parts of chess. Focus on openings you want to remember. Study endgames that appear often. Learn how to attack, defend, trade pieces, or make better plans. Ask for tips that match your current skill level instead of getting the same advice every player receives.

The conversation is just as important as the game. Ask “What if I move here?” Ask “What was my best move?” Ask “Why did my attack fail?” Ask “Can you explain that in a simpler way?” The app is built for questions, so you are never limited to playing in silence.

There is no need to switch between different tools just to play and learn. The chessboard and the conversation work together. You make a move, ask a question, get an answer, and keep playing. Everything happens in one place, making practice smooth and enjoyable.

Whether you play one game a week or many games every day, the app is ready. Beginners can build confidence. Casual players can have fun. Club players can explore ideas. Anyone who enjoys chess can have interesting conversations while playing.

Use the app to play complete games, test new ideas, understand difficult positions, review finished games, and discover better moves. Learn at your own pace. Stay curious. Ask as many questions as you like. Every move is another chance to think, learn, and enjoy the game. If you want a chess game that also talks with you, teaches you, and helps you improve inside ChatGPT, this app is ready to play.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT 即可下棋。几秒钟内开始新对局，用日常棋类语言走棋，并在对弈过程中讨论每个环节。你可以询问某步棋为何好或不好、接下来该怎么走，或如何提升棋艺。这款应用面向希望同时享受下棋、学习和乐趣的人。

这款应用易于使用。只需开始一局并走棋。你可以使用简单的走法名称、标准国际象棋记谱法，或用普通英语提问。如果不确定该怎么走，就寻求帮助。聊天过程中棋局会继续，因此学习过程自然流畅，不像阅读一篇冗长课程。

如果你刚开始学棋，这款应用是友好的入门之选。它会用简单的小步骤讲解概念，告诉你每种棋子能做什么，以及为什么有些走法比其他走法更有力。你不必假装听懂了，继续提问即可。你可以一次学会一步棋。

如果你已经会下棋，还可以深入学习。讨论开局、中局、残局、战术、策略、计划和常见错误。询问某个局面对哪一方更有利的原因。比较不同走法，探索新思路。对话会根据你的问题灵活调整。

按自己的节奏下棋。可以长考，也可以快速走棋。停下来询问某个局面，回看之前的着法，尝试另一种思路并看看可能出现什么结果。国际象棋不只是找出最佳走法，也要理解这步棋为何有效。

应用可以用清晰的语言讲解捉双、牵制、串击、闪击、双将、弃子、通路兵、王的安全、棋子活跃度、空间、先手等许多棋类概念。遇到难题时，随时可以要求再次解释，让复杂主题更容易理解。

想提高棋艺？对局结束后复盘。讨论关键转折、错失的机会和精彩着法。询问棋局在哪一步发生变化，寻找自己的走棋模式。不要只知道错误发生了，还要从中学习。每盘棋都是进步的机会。

你也可以针对棋艺的特定方面练习。重点学习希望记住的开局，研究常见残局，学习如何进攻、防守、兑换棋子或制定更好的计划。根据你当前的水平获取建议，而不是听所有棋手都会收到的相同建议。

对话和棋局同样重要。你可以问：“如果我走这里会怎样？”问：“我这盘棋的最佳着法是什么？”问：“我的进攻为什么失败了？”问：“能不能讲得更简单一点？”这款应用专为提问而设计，因此你不必默默下棋。

无需为了下棋和学习而在不同工具之间切换。棋盘和对话协同运作：你走一步棋，提出问题，获得回答，然后继续下棋。一切都在同一处完成，让练习流畅又愉快。

无论你每周下一盘棋，还是每天对弈多盘，这款应用都随时可用。初学者可以建立信心，休闲玩家可以享受乐趣，俱乐部棋手可以探索新思路。任何喜欢国际象棋的人都能在对弈时展开有趣的交流。

你可以用这款应用下完整棋局、测试新思路、理解复杂局面、复盘已结束的对局并发现更好的走法。按自己的节奏学习，保持好奇，尽管提问。每一步棋都是思考、学习和享受乐趣的新机会。如果你想在 ChatGPT 中体验一款会与你交流、教你下棋并帮助你进步的棋类应用，它已准备就绪。

payload.name: FantasyBot Sports
payload.description: AI 首发/弃用、弃权与交易
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FantasyBot Sports is your AI fantasy sports assistant for fantasy football, basketball, baseball, and hockey.

Ask in plain English:

- "Should I start Jefferson or Chase this week?" (start/sit advice with projections and matchups)
- "Is this trade fair?" (trade analysis with player values and rest-of-season outlook)
- "Who should I pick up off waivers?" (waiver targets with suggested drops)
- "Compare Jokic and Embiid" (head-to-head player comparisons)
- "Top 30 WRs this season" (position rankings for any sport)
- "How's my team looking?" (roster grades, matchup previews, league power rankings)

No league setup needed to start: player stats with trends and matchup grades, trade analysis with market values for both sides, start/sit calls for any players, trending adds and drops across all fantasy platforms, player trade values, position rankings, and head-to-head comparisons.

Connect your Sleeper, ESPN, Yahoo, or other supported league in the FantasyBot app and answers use your actual roster: start/sit verdicts for every slot in your lineup, waiver pickups actually available in your league with safe drop candidates, your team's grade with positional strengths and weaknesses, your weekly matchup outlook, opponent roster lookups, and where you rank in your league's power rankings.

Every answer is backed by real player stats, projections, injury status, and trend data, shown in interactive cards right in the chat.

Supports: Fantasy Football (NFL), Fantasy Basketball (NBA), Fantasy Baseball (MLB), Fantasy Hockey (NHL).
payload.longDescription:

在 FantasyBot 应用中连接你的 Sleeper、ESPN、Yahoo 或其他支持的联赛，答案将基于你的实际阵容：每个阵容位置的首发/弃用判断，你联赛中实际可用的弃权目标及安全放弃人选，你的球队评分及位置强弱分析，每周对阵展望，对手阵容查询，以及你在联盟实力排名中的位置。

每个答案都基于真实球员数据、预测、伤病状态和趋势数据，以交互式卡片形式直接在聊天中展示。

支持：幻想美式足球（NFL）、幻想篮球（NBA）、幻想棒球（MLB）、幻想冰球（NHL）。
